messages:
Sophia: CI canary on h100 failed in nightly warmup — seeing OOM and an \"invalid device function\" in the warmup logs. Can someone kick a rerun on a different pool and take a quick look?

Kevin: can you paste the small nvidia-smi and the kernel log snippet? also drop the CI job url if you have it.

Sophia: sure — job: https://ci.redwoodinfra.internal/987654
```
> nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,cuda_version --format=csv
535.54, 12.2
```
```
Warmup log excerpt:
[2026-03-18T03:12:45Z] warmup.cpp:142 ERROR kernel_launch: invalid device function
[2026-03-18T03:12:45Z] warmup.cpp:148 ERROR allocator: failed to allocate 2.0 GiB: OOM
XID 137 reported in kernel log
```

Ajay: looks like a possible driver/toolkit skew or PTX mismatch. Our canary-h100 pool runs driver 535.86 in infra, image uses cuda 12.2 runtime. If the build included PTX compiled for a different SM, you can see invalid-device-function. Quick check: can you rerun on canary-a100 and canary-h100-2?

Jordan: +1 to trying a100. If a100 passes and h100 fails, that points to an architecture-targeting issue rather than pure memory.

Sophia: I can't repro this locally (same image) which is why I'm asking for a rerun. Kicked infra request for those two pools — thanks.

infra-bot: Rerun request accepted. Queued jobs: canary-h100-2 (job 987661), canary-a100-1 (job 987662). ETA ~10m.

ci-bot: Job 987661 started on canary-h100-2. Job 987662 started on canary-a100-1. I'll post status updates.

Kevin: if both fail, we should bisect against driver versions (535.54 -> 535.86) and also try swapping the container's cuda runtime to 12.1/12.2 pinned images to see if it's PTX vs SASS mismatch.

Sophia: noted. I also pushed a tiny reproducer (warmup-only) to https://gist.github.com/sophia/abc123 — please use that for quick local checks.

ci-bot: Job 987661 (canary-h100-2) finished: PASSED ✅
Job 987662 (canary-a100-1) finished: FAILED ❌ — OOM and kernel log includes:
```
[2026-03-18T03:27:18Z] kernel: GPU0: XID 137: Invalid device function
```
Logs uploaded: https://ci.redwoodinfra.internal/987662/logs

Ajay: interesting — h100 passed, a100 failed. That flips the expectation. Could be the container image included an sm80-compiled cubin but a100 needs sm80/75 differences? I'll pull the artifact and inspect the libdevice/ptx.

Kevin: can you also capture the output of `cuobjdump --info` from the failing job artifact so we can confirm which SASS/PTX were bundled? if it's missing a100 SASS that matches invalid device function makes sense.

Sophia: thanks everyone. tagging this as rerun-complete for now. Ajay, ping me if you want me to requeue with pinned runtime or a different compiler flag. :thumbsup:

Ajay: I'll take it from here — might ask for a quick rebuild with explicit `-arch=sm_86` flags if necessary. Appreciate the fast help.

ci-bot: Thread closed (reruns complete). If you need further automated bisecting, comment `@ci-bot bisect drivers 535.54..535.86` and I'll start a binary search across driver builds.
